verdict: All six source scopes and full numbered/source-alias duplicate relationships pass in this bounded audit.
findings: Physical69–70 precisely requires positive integer terms, the entire initial segment, coefficients1/2 and both endpoints1. No monotonicity or disjoint binary support is added; no zero coefficients/gaps are permitted. This differs from Hindman–Leader–Strauss finite-sums plus consecutive(1,2,1) target and from inconsistent unrestricted Milliken–Taylor systems.

Physical51 defines X as any nonempty finite or infinite alphabet and X* as nonempty finite words. Physical54 defines A_x by the first occurrence and B_x as the position AFTER that occurrence. Physical70 permits a bounded nonnegative gap between first occurrences and demands every increasing-index concatenation have one color. Root retained the exact quantifiers and does not count the already proved no-gap theorem.

Physical91 gives connected graphs, alternate cop-first moves including staying, and domination by CLOSED neighbourhood containment in earlier induced initial segments. Physical92 defines weak win by finitely many visits to every vertex; no local-finiteness or countability hypothesis is stated for these questions. Physical97 defines local constructibility by finite induced supersets, faithfully reproduced.

Physical111 distinguishes structural weak-win classification from the weaker finite-set evacuation property and explicitly asks whether evacuation implies local constructibility. Root promotes that precise converse from the immediately following source prose, not the refuted local-constructible⇒weak-win assertion.

Physical111 repeated-return question has ∀ cop start ∃ robber start v ∀ positive m,n ∃ robber strategy, avoiding capture and either confined in a finite set forever or returning at t≥m and s≥t+n. The strategy may depend on m,n. Root matches this stronger two-return target; the already constructed two-ended example gives only one arbitrarily delayed return.

Physical117 torus family is generated by BOTH all horizontal and all vertical translates of an arbitrary three-set R; include empty union as usual. Translation transitivity makes each point frequency equal to average cardinality/n². Single cyclic orbit theorem and R={0,1,2} checked case are proper partial results.
